headword: {指導教官|しどうきょうかん}

definitions.gloss: academic advisor; thesis supervisor; supervising instructor
definitions.explanation: A professor or instructor who guides a student's research, thesis, or academic progress. Also used for supervising officers in military and professional training contexts.

examples.japanese: {指導教官|しどうきょうかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}した→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧。
examples.english: I consulted with my academic advisor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦テーマ→テーマ：17684_teema⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧{指導教官|しどうきょうかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I need to get my supervisor's approval for the thesis topic.

examples.japanese: {指導教官|しどうきょうかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧で、⟦しっかりした→しっかりする：21456_shikkarisuru⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦{成果|せいか}→成果：06745_seika⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to my supervisor being strict, I was able to produce solid research results.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{指導|しどう}→指導：03190_shidou⟧ (guidance, instruction) and {教官|きょうかん} (instructor, official teacher). In academic contexts, this refers to the professor who oversees a graduate student's thesis or dissertation research. In military or professional training, it refers to a supervising officer or drill instructor.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {指導教官|しどうきょうかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to choose an advisor
- {指導教官|しどうきょうかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{指示|しじ}→指示：09674_shiji⟧: the advisor's instructions
- {指導教官|しどうきょうかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to conduct research under one's supervisor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{指導教員|しどうきょういん}→指導教員：09970_shidoukyouin⟧: supervising teacher — the more common term in current academic usage at many universities
- ⟦{担任|たんにん}→担任：16408_tannin⟧: homeroom teacher — the teacher in charge of a class in primary and secondary education
- ⟦ゼミ→ゼミ：00434_zemi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧: seminar professor — a casual way to refer to one's academic supervisor
